Definition: Judging by the survivors while ignoring the failures. The visible winners are a biased sample, because the losers are no longer around to be counted.
Example: Someone argues, 'Every successful CEO wakes at 5am, so waking at 5am causes success' — ignoring the many who woke early and failed.
FaithDiscussionExample: Someone argues, 'Every thriving church uses this method, so the method guarantees thriving' — ignoring the churches that used it and closed.
HowToRespond: Count the missing: "Let's also count the cases that didn't make it."
